ModMetaData.name: Xenogerm Planner
ModMetaData.author: Escarval
ModMetaData.description:
Xenogerm Planner is a planning and tracking mod for RimWorld's Biotech genetics system. It lets you create xenogerm plans before you own every genepack and track your progress as your colony collects the genes you need.
Create plans using all genes available in your game, import existing vanilla xenogerm templates, duplicate or copy and paste plans, and choose between All planned genes and Exact gene set modes. See which genes and genepacks are still missing, inspect available genepacks, review prerequisite genes and possible conflicts, and track useful genetic stats while editing.
Select a Gene Assembler to check whether it can assemble a plan right now, find pawns who may provide missing genes through a Gene Extractor, create normal RimWorld xenogerm templates once a plan is ready, and receive optional readiness notifications.
Planning currently covers the active map. Genepacks in caravans, on other maps, or still being offered by traders do not count toward plan readiness.
Optional Settlement Trade Overview integration can highlight genepacks for sale that contain genes useful for unfinished plans. Settlement Trade Overview is not required for normal Xenogerm Planner functionality.
Biotech is required. Harmony is not required.
Available in English, Russian, and Ukrainian.
